title: Kao Curel Body Wash Refill 340ml
tags: series-curel, item-body-wash, feat-fragrance-free, feat-colorant-free, concern-dryness, skin-dry
description: Curel Body Wash is a liquid body wash from Kao's Curel line, built around what the brand calls ceramide care: it washes away sweat and dirt while protecting ceramide, an essential component of the skin. The mild cleansing formula contains moisturizing ingredients and leaves dry-feeling skin moist and smooth after rinsing. Fragrance-free and colorant-free. This is the 340ml refill pouch for the liquid-type Curel Body Wash pump bottle; it is not for foam-type bottles.
ingredients:
Key ingredients include dipotassium glycyrrhizate.
Cleansing base — Includes alkyl glucoside and lauryl hydroxysultaine.
Plant extract — Eucalyptus extract.
Fragrance-free and colorant-free. Contains ethanol.
howto:
1. Refill only the liquid-type Curel Body Wash bottle. Use the bottle up completely, rinse the bottle and pump with tap water, drain well, then pour in the whole pouch.
2. Put a suitable amount on a wet towel or sponge and lather well.
3. Wash the body, then rinse off thoroughly.
4. Do not use on broken, swollen or irritated skin, and stop use if irritation appears. Keep out of eyes; rinse right away if it gets in.
highlights:
Washes away sweat and dirt while protecting ceramide, an essential skin component
Mild cleansing formula with moisturizing ingredients
Fragrance-free and colorant-free
340ml refill for the liquid-type pump bottle
faq:
Q: Can I pour this into a foam-type Curel bottle?
A: No. Kao says to refill only the liquid-type Curel Body Wash bottle; in a foam pump it will not foam and the pump may jam.
Q: Is it scented?
A: No. It is fragrance-free and colorant-free.
Q: How should I refill?
A: Use up the bottle completely, rinse the bottle and pump with tap water, drain well, then pour in the entire pouch. Do not mix it with other products.

title: Kao Keeping Smoother Ironing Wrinkle Remover Refill 310ml
description: Keeping Smoother is Kao's ironing spray for taking out wrinkles: sprayed on just before ironing, it makes fine laundry creases easier to press out, helps the iron glide more lightly and leaves fabric with a supple, lightly crisp finish while helping keep wrinkles from coming back. Kao suggests it for blouses, skirts and handkerchiefs. This is the 310ml refill pouch for the Keeping Smoother spray bottle.
ingredients:
Ingredients — Water-soluble polymer, silicone, fragrance.
Product type — Ironing finishing agent for clothing.
howto:
1. Pour into a Keeping Smoother Ironing Wrinkle Remover spray bottle only, and do not mix with other products.
2. Check the garment's care label and the iron temperature. Not for silk, rayon, or items that cannot be washed in water or machine-washed at home.
3. Spray from about 20cm (8 in) away until the fabric is lightly damp all over.
4. Iron right away on the dry setting.
5. Never put the product inside the iron. Ventilate well and avoid breathing in the spray; wipe up any spray on floors, which can become slippery.
highlights:
Makes fine laundry wrinkles easier to iron out
Helps the iron glide more lightly
Supple, lightly crisp finish that helps keep wrinkles from returning
310ml refill for the Keeping Smoother spray bottle
faq:
Q: Which fabrics should I avoid?
A: Kao lists silk, rayon and items that cannot be washed in water or machine-washed at home. Always check the care label first.
Q: Can it leave marks?
A: Some fabrics may spot, so test on an inconspicuous area first. Kao says such spots come out with a water wash.
Q: Can I pour it into the iron's water tank?
A: No. Kao says never to put the product inside the iron.
